text:
maria: Heads up — saw a routing regression where `X-Route` gets ignored when an `Authorization` header is present. Repro: curl -H 'X-Route: enterprise-east' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' https://gateway.redwood.local/api -> ends up in default-pool
sam: Can you drop the gateway access log for one of the failing requests?
maria: log extract:
```
[2024-05-12T09:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 src=10.2.5.8 method=POST path=/v1/complete headers={Authorization,User-Agent,X-Route} routed_to=default-pool reason='auth-priority'
```
jin: Hmm — did we enable the UA-priority heuristic last week? That should only run if signed header is absent.
alex: We intentionally landed precedence: signed-route > auth-tenant-claim > user-agent-heuristic > custom-header-fallback. If `Authorization` contains a tenant claim we treat it as authoritative. Might be a config drift in v2.
maria: Right, but for enterprise customers we sign `X-Route` at the edge. Those should be treated as higher than auth-tenant when signature verifies. The log shows `auth-priority` even though `X-Route` was present.
ops: That mapping causes quota attribution to flip to the org-level bucket instead of the enterprise reserved quota — producing zero-rated spikes for some tenants. We need this fixed fast.
deploy-bot: deploy: route-config rev=20240512-19 applied to staging (canary 10%)
sam: Proposed short-term patch: add explicit `precedence` array in gateway config and an `allow_unsigned: true|false` per header so the evaluator has deterministic ties. Example:
```
routing:
  precedence: ["signed:X-Route", "auth:tenant_claim", "ua:heuristic", "header:X-Route"]
  headers:
    X-Route:
      allow_unsigned: false
```
jin: Also add telemetry fields: emit `routing_evidence` with keys {source, key, matched_rule} so we can query how decisions were made and correlate quota hits.
maria: Console UX requirement: show the "effective route" and the top-2 reasons (e.g., signed header verified, tenant claim matched) in the request inspector. Ops wants an alert if quota attribution differs between evaluated route and billed route by >5%.
alex: I can prototype an admin endpoint `/internal/routing/evaluate?req_id=` that returns the decision trace for a given request id. Will wire it to staging canary.
ops: Add tests: spoofed UA + missing signature should not allow header takeover. CC @security for threat model review.
security: Acknowledged. We'll provide a short checklist: replayed requests, signature verification failures, header ordering fuzz tests.
maria: Cool — wontfix: we should not try to auto-fix precedence in the client. Keep gateway authoritative. I'll open a PR with the precedence config and tests, and add a follow-up for console UX.
sam: Thanks — assign to `eng-platform/routing` and tag `priority:high`. :thumbsup:
